correctness.rationale: Exactly two independent d-sets of the 2d-cycle by cyclic gap counting; the bounded-independence complex is exactly the join of two simplex boundaries. Radial projection from barycenters is equivariant, giving a representation sphere. Orthogonal half-turn eigenspaces have dimensions (d-2,d) for even d or (d-1,d-1) for odd d, with the exceptional d=2 p=0 handled separately. The quotient of a positive/antipodal orthogonal sphere is S^{p-1}*RP^{q-1}; projective integral homology and suspension yields every claimed group and the first torsion threshold. verify.py exact finite checks d=2..8 passed but infinite result rests on complete proof.

value.rationale: Canonical central rotation on a natural infinite graph-complex family produces an exact homeomorphism model for the orbit space and a sharp d=4 integral Z/2 torsion transition, in arbitrarily many homology degrees, despite each unquotiented complex being a sphere. These nonrational quotient invariants cannot be deduced from the known sphere ranks and rational orientation characters. This is a natural complete classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
